title: [SOLVED] initramfs hangs on triggering udev during system boot
body: Not sure if this is the correct subforum for this, but the initramfs behavior that I witnessed recently is something that I haven't seen yet while working with arch. Within the past few weeks I noted that my system was taking a long time to boot, initially I thought it was having issues finding the encrypted drive but that was not the case. initramfs was hanging at "triggering udev" for over a minute before a behavior I can only describe as "timing out" occurs. I call it "timing out" since eventually the usb mouse and keyboard come online, I can tell because the rgb cycles and you can then type when prompted for the encryption password. I had my mouse and keyboard plugged into a USB switch originally and bypassed these to go straight to the PC tower. The system booted right away. I booted another PC with the USB switch connected and that system booted up right away. I plugged that USB switch back into the original PC and it exhibited the same hangup at triggering udev in initramfs. I read in some obscure post last night that someone had once experienced behavior like this and unplugged their PSU for thirty minutes and it resolved itself. Low and behold, I performed that action and there's no longer a hangup for udev when booting while connected to this usb hub. Has anyone seen this behavior here before? If not I hope this post can be helpful to whoever it happens to next. **UPDATE** Ended up being an issue with the ASUS ROG STRIX X870E motherboards bluetooth controller during boot. This issue is currently known and the work around is to either: A.) Disable bluetooth controllers in the BIOS and buy a separate bluetooth/wifi USB device. Or B.) Power down the system, unplug power for 10 seconds, restart the system. (From my personal experience the issue continues to come back after a system reboot even after following this method) See the following Github link for more information on these Mediatek driver issues: https://github.com/jetm/mediatek-mt7927-dkms/issues/23 Recommended linux compatible bluetooth adapters: https://github.com/morrownr/USB-WiFi/bl … r_Linux.md Updated 05-09-2025 Recommended linux wifi adapters: https://github.com/morrownr/USB-WiFi/bl … drivers.md Updated 05-07-2026 Last edited by wickedmechanic (2026-08-16 00:46:56)
